title: santalodes heterophyllum
intro: Santalodes heterophyllum, commonly known as the White Sandalwood, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and calming effects. The health benefits of Santalodes heterophyllum include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and possessing antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include various compounds such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of calming and soothing the nervous system.
